content: Overview
--------
This playbook consolidates recurring customer-facing failures we see across Hosted API, Dedicated, and Private deployments in three clusters: (A) KV-cache evictions and stale-prefix hits, (B) sudden rate-limit bursts causing upstream 429s and tail latency, and (C) Private/VPC networking misconfigurations that manifest as TLS handshake or circuit errors during rollout. The goal is to provide triage steps, short-term mitigations, and owners for long-term fixes so CSRs and SREs can restore service quickly and communicate clearly to customers.

- Affected services: redwood-hosted (api.redwood.ai), redwood-dedicated (customer-dedicated pools), redwood-private (VPC-controlled deployments)."}, {"source": "sources/confluence/customer-success-and-support/support-process/jira-field-guidelines-and-sla-timers.json", "chunk": "6/17", "kind": "Confluence page", "title": "Jira Field Guidelines + SLA Timers (SUP Tickets)", "status": "published", "date": "2026-02-18", "text": "### When to assign Incident Severity

This charter is the source of truth for what the support agent may and may not do. It takes precedence over proposals, drafts, Slack threads, and older pages where they disagree.
## Credits and disputes
- Support can issue duplicate-charge credit notes only on self-serve accounts.
- Support may not issue a credit note of any amount on an account with a signed contract (Enterprise).
- For a confirmed duplicate on a contract account, open a dispute on the duplicated line (reason `duplicate_charge`, with the request IDs) and hand the case to Billing Ops with the invoice number, the line and the dispute id. Billing Ops applies contract-account adjustments under the contract."}, {"source": "sources/confluence/policies-and-process/delegation-of-authority/support-charter-2027.json", "chunk": "3/4", "kind": "Confluence page", "title": "Support Charter 2027: What the Support Agent May and May Not Do", "status": "published", "date": "2027-03-24", "text": "## Support may

- Explain billing behaviour from the published pages.
- Issue a duplicate-charge credit note on a self-serve account, within the limit Finance sets.
- Open a dispute on a duplicated line.
- Open a case with the team the routing page names, and tell the customer who has it.
## Support may not
- Issue goodwill, SLA or exception credits, or any refund.
- Promise an amount, an outcome or a date for something another team decides.
- Change payment methods or take card numbers.
- Quote figures from a customer's contract.
- Change a customer's plan, limits or reservation."}, {"source": "sources/confluence/product-docs/pricing-and-packaging/discounting-and-credits-policy-for-usage-based-products.json", "chunk": "10/20", "kind": "Confluence page", "title": "Discounting and Credits Policy for Usage-Based Products", "status": "published", "date": "2026-02-22", "text": "## Dedicated usage: credits and discounts

body: ## Purpose
The support console can look up a customer's billing account, issue a credit note against invoice lines, and open a billing dispute. This page defines when Support uses each one. It amends the billing routing page for duplicate charges only; everything else on that page still applies. This version is effective from 26 February 2027 and adds how to tell the copy from the original. Support's per-line limit is set in Finance's Billing Adjustments Approval Matrix (Finance shared drive), which FP&A revised in February 2027; check the matrix for the limit that applies to the invoice in front of you."}, {"source": "sources/confluence/finance-and-legal/billing-controls/payment-failures-during-processor-incidents.json", "chunk": "4/4", "kind": "Confluence page", "title": "Payment Failures During Payment-Processor Incidents", "status": "published", "date": "2027-03-15", "text": "## Why no case inside the window
During a processor incident Billing Ops can't do anything the automatic retries won't already do, and a case per failed payment buried the queue during the 2026 incidents. The retries are tracked centrally by Billing Ops for the whole incident.
## Late fees and dunning
A payment that failed inside an incident window is not overdue until its retries have finished, so no dunning reminder is sent for it. Finance's collections schedule starts only after that.
## Questions
Ask in #support-billing. Page owner: Dev Patel.
